notes.title: Roadmap for 2025-2026
notes.content: [h1]Devlog & Roadmap — Magic Soldier[/h1][p][i]We've been working hard behind the scenes for almost four months to get the game back on track.[/i][/p][p][i]We're not going to lie to you: we've come a long way.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]🔥 Over the last 4 months, we’ve been putting in a [b]huge amount of work[/b] to get things stable again.  [/h3][p]Server crashes, client crashes, frozen players, broken quests, rollback issues with XP or inventory...  [/p][p]Yeah, we went through a [b]storm[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]There’s nothing worse for creators than seeing their game — their baby — not working properly.[/p][p][/p][p]I’ll be honest with you:  [/p][p]We’ve thought about **stopping everything** more than once.  [/p][p]When we see around 600 registered accounts, but only 5 players connected... it’s disheartening.  [/p][p]But we take a step back and remind ourselves:  [/p][p][b]If those 5 people love the game, then there’s hope — others will too.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We faced bugs where we genuinely said:  [/p][p][i]This one… we might not get through it.[/i][/p][p]And yet — [b]we did[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Every single day, we work to make [b]Magic Soldier better than the day before.  [/b][/p][p]We try to consider most of your suggestions, and believe me: [b]every single idea is studied[/b].  [/p][p]Most of them have actually already been implemented.[/p][p][/p][p]🧑‍💻 Just as a reminder: we’re only [b]two indie devs.[/b]  [/p][p]That means Magic Soldier is developed [b]entirely in our free time[/b].  [/p][p]We both work regular jobs. We get up at 4AM, work until 11AM,  [/p][p]then after work we get back to developing until 10PM or even later.  [/p][p]Our days are [b]crazy long[/b], but we do it because we love this project.[/p][p][/p][p]✅[b]And today, we can finally breathe a little.[/b]  [/p][p]We’ve fixed [b]almost all the major critical bugs[/b].  [/p][p]The game is now [b]stable, reliable, and ready[/b] for what’s coming next.[/p][p]And speaking of what’s next…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469210/05a6f48a0cf67221f833580512e3dee66fb15c52.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]🗺️Roadmap — 2025 to 2026[/h1][p][b]We’re planning a total of 6 content updates, and 2 major milestone updates (1.5 and 2.0) by the end of 2026.[/b][/p][p]Until patch [b]1.5, our main focus will be crafting and improving progression[/b] between levels 30 and 100.  [/p][p]Leveling can feel too repetitive past level 30, and crafting currently feels too basic.[/p][p]To address this, before our first major update (*Soul of the Weapon*), we’ll release two updates focused on:[/p][p]- New [b]dungeons[/b][/p][p]- New [b]area[/b][/p][p]- New [b]crafting professions/skills[/b][/p][p]- [b]The Class Weapon Questline[/b][/p][p][i]⚔️ The Class Weapon will be the strongest weapon in the game at level 100.[/i]  [/p][p][/p][p][b]Max-level players — you’ll definitely want to complete this quest![/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Patch 1.5 — Soul of the Weapon[/b][/h2][p]- Crafting becomes [b]more complex and rewarding (goodbye “1 silver stone = OP item”)[/b]  [/p][p]- Start of the [b]Ancestral Armor questline[/b] (available from level 100)  [/p][p]- This will be the [b]strongest armor[/b] for [b]level 110 players[/b][/p][p] [i]🛡️ Like the Class Weapon, the Ancestral Armor [b]will be extremely difficult to obtain[/b].[/i]  [/p][p][i]But it’s endgame gear — it should be earned.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Patch 2.0 — A Giant Leap[/b][/h2][p]This will be a major leap forward — both in terms of gameplay and core systems.  [/p][p]We’ll introduce three huge features we’ve dreamed about since the beginning:[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Elemental Damage & Resistance[/b][/h2][p]- Weapons, armor, and spells will have [b]elemental stats:[/b]  [/p][p][b]🔥 Fire, 💧 Water, 🌪️ Wind, 🌿 Earth[/b][/p][p]- These will be influenced by your [b]elemental class[/b][/p][p]- Some monsters [b]will be weak or resistant to certain types[/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Talent Trees[/b][/h2][p]- Each class will get [b]unique passives and spell choices[/b][/p][p]- This opens up [b]real build diversity[/b] and deep customization[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Passive spell[/b][/h2][p]- Passive spells that grant bonus stats, effects, or boosts automatically  [/p][p]- Strong synergies with talent trees and elemental builds[/p][p]During Patch 2.0, [b]you’ll also finish your full Ancestral Armor set.[/b]  [/p][p]And by then, you’ll fully understand the importance of having both your class weapon and armor,  [/p][p]especially as elemental stats become a core part of the game.[/p][p][/p][h3]💬 Thank you all so much for sticking with us.[/h3][h3]The hardest part is behind us — and the best is yet to come. — [/h3][h3][i]The Magic Soldier Dev Team[/i][/h3]

notes.title: Patch Note 1.0.2 is online
notes.content: [h2]Patch Note 1.0.2[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Track Quest[/b][/h3][p]A new feature is coming to Magic Soldier![/p][p]You asked us to be able to pin quests? We did it![/p][p]You asked us to have a more intuitive quest tracker? We did it![/p][p]In the next update, a new feature will be coming, and it will please new players (and perhaps even veterans!)[/p][p][b]You will now have access to Quest Tracker, which will display an arrow below your character, indicating the shortest path (in theory!) to reach your objective.[/b][/p][p]Some details about this system:[/p][p]- Some tasks will **intentionally** not be tracked.[/p][p]- The system does not take walls into account! If the arrow tells you to go straight, but a forest or a wall appears in front of you, be smart and go around it ;)[/p][p]The arrow will change color depending on the quest tracked.[/p][p]We are convinced that this addition will help retain many more players during their first two hours of play.[/p][p]I give you little footage on how work this system.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469210/75cb98c4274fe7bee706ac756abb28617a7bd4f4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Speaking of new players, [b]we have decided to rework the tutorial[/b] to make it more epic, more engaging, and more comprehensive.[/p][p][/p][p]I won't spoil anything for those who want to repeat the tutorial, but I'll leave you with a visual :)[/p][p][b]We will also be adding a tutorial for:[/b][/p][p][b]Crafting[/b][/p][p][b]The Battlepass[/b][/p][p][b]Daily quests + localization[/b][/p][p][b]How the title system, bestiary, etc. work[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]HUD Improvements[/b][/h3][p]You will now be able to directly view your karma, as well as your experience and profession level, directly from the character window.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Selling in shops[/b][/h3][p]A new button has appeared on each NPC offering to buy or sell. This will allow you to directly switch between buy/sell mode at the merchant, allowing you to also see all the items they accept, as well as their selling prices.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Quest icons have been revamped.[/b][/h3][p]I mentioned arrow colors just before.[/p][p]It will therefore match the new color code for quests above the character.[/p][p]I'll let you see the visuals for the icons and arrows.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469210/329665f90d12ee37c1ba45bddb9498fe4ac4a5a2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Work Faster, Not Harder![/b][/h3][p]A new tab appears in the character window. It is currently disabled and will be available later.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Bugfix[/b][/h3][p]- A bug related to crafting (impossible to exit crafting if the inventory is full) has been fixed.[/p][p]- Bags in the hotbar now open the correct bag.[/p][p]- Several small bugs have been fixed.[/p]

notes.title: Magic Soldier - Breath of Renewal
notes.content:
🌬️ Patch 1.0 – Breath of Renewal

The most ambitious update in Magic Soldier history is here.

⚔️ GAMEPLAY & SYSTEMS
🔓 Free to Play: The game is now 100% free for everyone.
🏹 Ranged Combat Rework:
Projectiles now automatically home in on your target.
Your character freezes briefly after attacking (based on attack speed).
🧙 Enchanting Rework:
New visual animations.
Fully redesigned UI for clarity and immersion.
🧼 Item Deletion: Permanently delete unwanted items with confirmation.
🧪 Persist on Death Effects: Some effects (like EXP potions) now remain after dying.
🧠 Major Fixes:
Monster respawn bugs → fixed
TAB targeting bug → fixed
New red flash when taking damage → added
😊 Character:
Max character 4 → 8

🎟️ BATTLEPASS
Access it from the top-left corner of the game menu.
50 levels of rewards: cosmetics, titles, items, and more.
100% Free for all players.
Earn Battlepass XP by daily quest (craft, battle, and more soon !).

Progression Modes:

🔁 Equal: XP is shared between all active passes.
📌 Priority: XP goes to one pass at a time, in order.
🪄 Simultaneous: All active passes get full XP.

⚠️ Known Bug: You can currently claim rewards with a full inventory — items may be lost. A fix is coming soon.

🛡️ ITEMS & INVENTORY
💎 Moonstone:
Adds 2 death protection charges to any equipped item.
One charge is consumed per death to prevent item loss.
📦 Magic Coin Balance now appears in your inventory (reopen to refresh).
📈 Stat cap increased: from 999 ➜ 1500.
💰 ECONOMY & SHOP
🛍️ In-Game Shop Integration: Accessible from anywhere, no more NPCs.
📉 Magic Coin Conversion:
Old rate: 1 MC = 1
New rate: 1 old MC ≈ 0.625 new MC
All old balances have been converted. Item prices adjusted.
📦 Shop prices updated to match the new economy.
💬 Discord Magic Coins:
Before: 1 MC every 30 seconds
Now: 1 MC every 1 hour

💵 New MC Packages:

€4.99 → 250 MC
€9.99 → 550 MC (+50 bonus)
€14.99 → 900 MC (+150 bonus)
€24.99 → 1500 MC (+300 bonus)
€49.99 → 3200 MC (+700 bonus)
📆 DAILY QUESTS
🗓️ New profession and hunting dailies available.
🔁 Reset daily at 6 PM (server time).
🪙 Earn Daily Coins for a rotating monthly reward shop.
👑 INTERFACE & QUALITY OF LIFE
🖥️ Full UI redesign — clean, retro-modern, and responsive.
🕒 New HUD info:
Local Time
Server Time
Current Magic Coin Balance
🗺️ NEW CONTENT
🌒 New Zone: Noxilbane (Level 95+)
📚 Bestiary: View stats, drops and level (Character window)
🏷️ Titles: 60 unlockable titles with rarities ⚪ 🟢 🔵 🟣 🟡 🔴 🟠
🎁 New Items:
Noxilbane Relic (Lv. 90 – DEF, MDEF, Speed)
Gibli Pet (Lv. 99)
Moonstone, Daily Coins, Auras, Skins, and more
Next time, each comestic will had video on descriptions for preview
🤝 REFERRAL SYSTEM
🎯 Referral Link: https://playmagicsoldier.com/en/referral
Also accessible via My Account → Referral
Unlock up to 5 reward tiers.
Referees also receive a welcome bonus.
📢 FROM THE DEVELOPERS

"There are just two of us, but thousands of you dreaming with us."

Coming soon: Account-wide bank, class quests, elemental story arcs, a new class, gear balance, live events, and more secret systems 👀
Thank you for your feedback, passion, and support — you shape the game as much as we do.
🎟️ TOTHEMOON 🎟️

⚔️ Onward, Soldier. The magic calls.

notes.title: ✨ Development Update
notes.content:
✅ It’s done! The changes have been implemented and everything’s running smoothly. Huge thanks for your patience and feedback 🫶 Here’s what’s been fixed and improved:

🛠️ Spell Latency
We finally identified the cause of the spell latency bug. The more enhanced gear a player wore, the worse the lag became — all due to a miscalculation in the code. That issue is now fully fixed, leading to smoother, more responsive combat! 🧙‍♀️✨

♻️ Energy Reset Bug
The bug that sometimes prevented energy points from resetting has also been resolved. You can now dive back into your instances without any trouble! (/reset) ⚡🌀

🖥️ New Server
We tackled a major server architecture issue, allowing us to migrate to a much more powerful machine. The result? Better performance, increased stability, and more room for all the wild ideas we’re cooking up. Dreaming big, as always 🚀

Thanks again for your amazing support 💖
Stay tuned — more updates are just around the corner!

notes.title: ✨ Dev Update - Sunday, April 13th from 6 PM to 10 PM (UTC+2)
notes.content:
🛠️ Spell Latency Issue
We’ve identified the cause of the annoying lag on some spells. Turns out, the more upgraded gear you had equipped, the worse the latency became — all due to a miscalculation in the code. This will be fully fixed in the next update, bringing smoother and more responsive combat! 🧙‍♂️⚔️

♻️ Energy Reset Bug
Another long-standing issue: energy points sometimes wouldn’t reset properly. We’ve tracked it down and fixed it — and this fix will be part of the upcoming patch. Get ready to fight in instance freely again! 🔄⚡

🖥️ New Server
We’ve resolved a major backend architecture issue, which means we’re now ready to move the game to a much more powerful server. You can expect better stability, faster response times, and room for expansion. We’re thinking big! 🚀

Thanks for being such an amazing community — your feedback and support keep us going strong ❤️
Stay tuned, the update is just around the corner!
